statement: For a closed discrete free proper interior disk operator group with an actual transitive boundary-fixed commuting subgroup, the supremum operator metric is compatible, its infimum-orbit quotient is the actual metric covering, and the original relative centralizer embeds as a closed isometric subgroup of the uniform equivariant group. Compact parameter families supported over one fixed compact quotient set extend with their inverses to the original circle; every based sphere family supported in one compact quotient subsurface with nonempty fixed boundary fills in the actual relative centralizer. Evaluation after fixing finitely many orbit labels is an actual locally trivial bundle, and every finite-label inclusion induces an isomorphism on all positive homotopy groups. For a noncompact quotient, an explicit escaping-disk sequence proves that descent from the induced original topology to the Whitney topology is not continuous, even on the compact-quotient-isotopy subgroup.
depends_on: C30 verified Polish open evaluation theorem; C64 proved compact-covering lemma; actual covering homotopy lifting and displayed local bundle charts; independently verified Yagasaki compact-pair Lemma 2.1(ii) and noncompact-surface Theorem 1.1; direct metric and compact-core proofs; verified Lech-Michalik-Rybicki majorant topology and fragmentation scope
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), exact discrete-operator topology, fixed quotient-support sphere fillings, and finite-configuration continuation for the remaining level-zero question.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual transitive boundary-fixed source subgroup is an explicit hypothesis. Every restriction, descent, evaluation and covering-lift map is retained, with its original topology and exact inverse or local bundle chart. The original circle is used throughout, and no extension of arbitrary uniform homeomorphisms or original operators across it is assumed.
computational_checks: This qualitative theorem uses direct metric equalities, compact-family evaluations, explicit local bump translations, covering uniqueness, and a specified escaping-disk sequence. It introduces no finite classification or numerical approximation. The sequence is a general construction with exact inequalities, rather than a numerical example.
notes: The fixed compact support and finite-configuration conclusions do not give a coherent infinite configuration limit or controlled fragmentation of every original family. C12 remains open in that general scope. The original relative subgroup is a closed isometric image; the proof gives an actual rotation outside that image for the trivial operator case. Sources are checked at their precise hypotheses, including nonempty relative boundary for compact-surface contractibility and the compact quotient in the uniform-cover theorem. Previously accepted and frozen fragments are unchanged.
